candidateAdapterContract.rule: Do not invent a conversion to a scorer input format. Only use an adapter that is already fixed by independently verifiable historical code/provenance before reference/gold is opened.

acceptedBaseline.rule: Baseline identity and accepted scores are frozen context only; do not reinterpret or retune them during Phase D.

gold.rule: Gold bytes must be restored/located and SHA256-reverified without exposing content to candidate construction/tuning before any score is authorized.

evaluator.required: The exact pre-existing full calibration evaluator that produced/defines the accepted Melody/Bass/Chords/Rhythm/overall comparison, plus its exact candidate adapter contract.

excludedSubstitutes.reason: Exact temporary V1.4.3 rhythm-segment grading program; WAV/rubric evidence with manual consistency component, not the established full calibration evaluator.
v1.4.3-rhythm-reference-grader-v1 wrapper; not proven to produce the accepted full calibration anchor vector.

evaluator.rule: No reconstructed, reverse-engineered, newly authored, or post-candidate scorer may substitute for the exact historical evaluator.

frozenEvaluationOrderIfAndOnlyIfUnblocke: Verify branch and preregistration identity without editing candidate or baseline.
Verify immutable candidate file SHA256 and canonical event SHA256.
Verify recovered exact evaluator and adapter identities against pre-frozen historical provenance.
Verify Gold bytes SHA256 equals the frozen expected Gold SHA256 before evaluator execution.
Run exactly one comparison of the immutable candidate using the frozen evaluator/adapter and Gold.
Persist criterion-wise evidence, exact score vector/deltas, input hashes, evaluator/adapter hashes, environment identity, and execution log.
Do not tune, search, generate a second candidate, alter thresholds, rerun audio/CQT, or automatically promote after viewing the result.
Seal the one-use scoring path and checkpoint the result.
stopRules: Any false GO gate means STOP before opening reference/gold content or computing a score.
A plausible substitute scorer is not sufficient.
A scorer reconstructed from accepted scores or Gold contents is prohibited.
No Modal/L4/GPU/audio recomputation is authorized by this preregistration.
No Production/main integration or automatic promotion is authorized.
